subject: english
question: What is the one-word substitute for: "A condition in which an organism has only one copy of a particular chromosome, instead of the usual two"?
solution: The correct answer is: **1) Monosomy**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Monosomy"** refers to a genetic condition in which an organism has only one copy of a particular chromosome instead of the usual two. (एक गुणसूत्र की कमी) • **Example:** Turner syndrome is a condition caused by monosomy of the X chromosome in humans. • Monosomy often results in developmental abnormalities or disorders because the missing chromosome leads to a lack of essential genetic material. (आवश्यक आनुवंशिक सामग्री की कमी के कारण विकासात्मक असामान्यताएँ होती हैं।) Therefore, the correct answer is: **1) Monosomy**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Trisomy** (त्रिसोमी): A genetic condition where there are three copies of a particular chromosome instead of the usual two. • **Example:** Down syndrome is caused by trisomy of chromosome 21. • **Polyploidy** (बहुगुणसूत्रता): A condition where an organism has more than two complete sets of chromosomes, common in plants. • **Example:** Many species of wheat are polyploid, giving them advantageous traits like increased size. • **Aneuploidy** (असामान्य गुणसूत्र संख्या): A condition where the total number of chromosomes is not a multiple of the usual haploid number due to an extra or missing chromosome. • **Example:** Aneuploidy is a key feature in many types of cancer cells. 46:T10f6, सही उत्तर है: **1) मोनोसोमी**।
